gaps_html:
About the Benelux data

Built from the Benelux research files (28 records on the map, 23 accounts, researched 15 October 2026): benelux/projects.csv, territory-plan.md, sources.md and lilly-katwijk-battlecard.md. Amounts, dates, notes and confidence are as written there. The town coordinates, the Orise fit ratings and the opportunity status were added when loading: fit areas are matched from the wording of each row's "Relevant to Orise" note and the strength follows its High / Med / Low rating. Open means High and Med-High in or near the window; Monitor means Med, Low and watch items; Closed/late means divested, closed or bankrupt sites and nothing in window. No project was found in Luxembourg.

  • Totals are a floor. Many projects have no disclosed amount (MSD Boxmeer, IRE, PanTera, Trasis). UCB Arkelia is €100M or €200M depending on the source, so neither is counted; Fagron's €70M is US and Netherlands combined; Galapagos's €275M is a wind-down charge, not capex. USD amounts are converted at 1 USD = 0.86 EUR.
  • Left out: the UCB US biologics campus (Georgia, USD 2bn) is in the CSV as context only and is not shown or counted.
  • Dates that differ by source: GSK NewLyo operational H1 or H2 2027; UCB Genesis first production 2026 or first batches 2027; Lilly Katwijk's municipality says the building permit is granted while press says permits are still missing (these are different permits: building, nature, environmental and water); PanTera permits dated 2025 or April 2026; BMS Leiden completion 2024 or 2025.
  • Greenfield / brownfield follows the CSV: Lilly Katwijk, BMS Leiden, PanTera and the Pfizer Puurs land are greenfield; the Chiesi-style conversions and expansions are brownfield. Rows with no project (n/a) default to brownfield.
  • Account merging: MSD and MSD Animal Health share the existing "Merck & Co." card; J&J Innovative Medicine shares the J&J card; Astellas Meppel is shown under its new owner Delpharm.

Gaps and next steps (from the territory plan)

  1. GSK Wavre: confirm NewLyo schedule and scope after the 14 Oct 2026 works council; watch the final social plan and any pause.
  2. UCB: resolve Arkelia €100M vs €200M and Genesis first-batch timing.
  3. Pfizer Puurs: find which isolator and freezer modules are complete; watch the RUP outcome and the Omgevingsloket.
  4. MSD Boxmeer: investment amount and contractors. MSD Oss: Organon's plans. J&J: Belgian press room and Omgevingsloket; check the reported Ghent cell-therapy site.
  5. Permitting: Omgevingsloket (Flanders), permis unique (Wallonia), officielebekendmakingen.nl (NL) and Luxembourg commodo-incommodo were not reachable by the research tools; a browser is needed.
  6. Lilly Katwijk: permit decision (gmb-2026-471169) and appeal deadlines, the nitrogen-permit appeal, the main contractor and EPCM, and site leadership. The battlecard refers to ireland/lilly-battlecard.md; that Ireland battlecard was not in the files provided.
  7. Takeda Lessines: is the new plant operating? Delpharm Meppel and Organon Oss: new owners' plans. IRE and Trasis: project values and automation scope. Legend: 2026 capex status. Galapagos Leiden and Univercells Jumet: buyers of the sites.
  8. Baxter, Novartis, AbbVie, AstraZeneca, Roche: nothing found in Belgium or the Netherlands; re-check with paid tools or company contact. Rousselot and Eurofins Luxembourg: nothing found.
  9. Agencies and trade press (FIT, AWEX, BioWin, NFIA, pharma.be, BioVox) were not read. Tech stacks and contacts beyond Lilly Katwijk are not researched; no emails, phone numbers or LinkedIn URLs were collected.
